title: Bottom of the Spectrum of Complete Kähler Metrics from Finite-Mass Plurisubharmonic Exhaustions
summary: Let $Ω\subset\mathbb{C}^{n}$ be a bounded domain, and let $ρ:Ω\to[-1,0)$ be a smooth strictly plurisubharmonic exhaustion function. We consider the logarithmic potential $g=-\log(-ρ)$ and the associated complete Kähler metric $ω=dd^{c}g$. We prove that if $ρ$ satisfies the finite weighted Monge--Ampère mass condition $\int_Ω(-ρ)^{\varepsilon}(dd^{c}ρ)^{n} 0$, then the bottom of the spectrum of the Laplace--Beltrami operator of $(Ω,ω)$ satisfies $λ_{0}(Δ_ω,Ω)=n^{2}$.
